text: M05 `rehyxchp` (2.1.9) puts a 'step 0' first: a tag its owner assigned a render to is shown with that component whatever its attributes. The same section keeps `todo` as the example of a tag that 'carries its own content and stays text as written'. But `todo` HAS an assigned render (M08 TodoChip, M51 `urs8n775`: editor and chat read the same assigned component), so applying step 0 literally turns every `<todo comment=…/>` in chat into a chip — and an empty one, because chat sanitization carries only `type/slug/slugs/tags/filter/anchor` (`comment` is dropped). Assumed (bounded rule, no names): step 0 applies to a tag with an assigned render whose declared attributes are all ones the chip carries; a tag whose content lives in another attribute (`todo`) stays text as the default render leaves it. The spec should say which: either step 0 is limited like this, or `todo` is shown by its render in chat (and then sanitization must carry `comment`).
assumption: ASSUMPTION:dev-0301 — chat step 0 (assigned render) only for tags whose attributes are all chip-carriable (src/client/chat/xml-chip-preprocess.ts, rendersInChat); `todo` stays text
